description: This file defines functions and configurations for a command-line interface schema related to a Radio Unit emulator, including PRACH format translation, logging setup, DPDK configuration, and overall emulator configuration parsing.

methods.name: str_to_prach_format
methods.description: Converts a string to the corresponding ru_emulator_prach_format enum value.

methods.name: prach_format_to_str
methods.description: Converts a ru_emulator_prach_format enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: configure_cli11_log_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for logging parameters.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ru_emu_dpdk_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for DPDK-related emulator parameters.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ru_emu_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for RU emulator parameters including bandwidth, compression, MAC addresses, VLAN, port IDs, timing, and PRACH format.

methods.name: ocudu::configure_cli11_with_ru_emulator_appconfig_schema
methods.description: Main function to set up CLI subcommands and parse emulator configuration.
